feedback_by_option.fil: Malalantad ka kung papasok sa amoy. Basahin lamang ang label kung walang exposure.
feedback_by_option.en: Reaching into the smell exposes you. Read the label only if you can do so without exposure.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag rutinang painumin nang marami. Sundin ang tagubilin ng poison adviser.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not give a routine large drink. Follow the instructions of the poison-advice responder.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Iwasan ang exposure, ilayo ang iba at unahing tawagan ang kumpirmadong emergency o poison adviser.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Avoid exposure, move others away and activate the verified emergency or poison-advice route first.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Ibigay ang label, tinatayang oras, paraan ng exposure, sintomas at edad, saka sundin ang tagubilin.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Give the label, estimated time, exposure route, symptoms and age, then follow their instructions.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag manghula o mag-imbento ng panlunas. Iulat ang facts at sundin ang responder.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not guess or improvise an antidote. Report the facts and follow the responder.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ibigay ang lahat ng ligtas na nakuhang facts: label, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
feedback_by_option.en: Give all the facts you have safely gathered: label, time, route, symptoms and age.
